slides.title: Hashing passwords with bcrypt
slides.html:
Hashing

Hashing passwords with bcrypt

  • Hash = one-way; you can't reverse it
  • bcrypt adds a salt so equal passwords hash differently
  • Cost 10–12 is a good balance
  • Hash in a pre("save") hook

models/User.js

import bcrypt from "bcryptjs";
 
userSchema.pre("save", async function () {
  if (!this.isModified("password")) return;
  this.password = await bcrypt.hash(this.password, 12);
});
 
userSchema.methods.checkPassword = function (plain) {
  return bcrypt.compare(plain, this.password);
};

slides.title: JSON Web Tokens
slides.html:
JWT

JSON Web Tokens

  • header.payload.signature
  • Payload is readable, not secret
  • Signature proves the server made it
  • Set a short expiry

tokens

import jwt from "jsonwebtoken";
 
const token = jwt.sign(
  { sub: user.id, role: user.role },
  process.env.JWT_SECRET,
  { expiresIn: "1d" }
);
 
const payload = jwt.verify(token, process.env.JWT_SECRET);
// { sub: "675a...", role: "author", iat: ..., exp: ... }

slides.title: The login controller
slides.html:
Login

The login controller

  • Same error for wrong email or password
  • select("+password") because it's hidden
  • Send the token in an httpOnly cookie

controllers/auth.js

export const login = async (req, res) => {
  const { email, password } = req.body;
  const user = await User.findOne({ email }).select("+password");
  if (!user || !(await user.checkPassword(password)))
    return res.status(401).json({ message: "Invalid email or password" });
 
  res.cookie("token", signToken(user), {
    httpOnly: true, secure: isProd, sameSite: "lax",
    maxAge: 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
  });
  res.json({ user: { id: user.id, name: user.name, role: user.role } });
};

slides.title: The protect middleware
slides.html:
Protect

The protect middleware

  • Read the token from cookie or header
  • Verify and load the user
  • Attach req.user for later handlers

middleware/auth.js

export const protect = async (req, res, next) => {
  const token = req.cookies?.token || bearer(req);
  if (!token) return res.status(401).json({ message: "Please log in" });
 
  try {
    const { sub } = jwt.verify(token, process.env.JWT_SECRET);
    req.user = await User.findById(sub);
    if (!req.user) throw new Error();
    next();
  } catch {
    res.status(401).json({ message: "Session expired, please log in" });
  }
};

slides.title: Roles and permissions
slides.html:
Roles

Roles and permissions

  • Store a role on the user
  • A small middleware factory checks it
  • Never let users set their own role

middleware/auth.js

// role: { type: String, enum: ["reader", "author", "admin"],
// default: "reader" }
 
export const allow = (...roles) => (req, res, next) =>
  roles.includes(req.user.role)
    ? next()
    : res.status(403).json({ message: "You don't have permission" });
 
router.post("/", protect, allow("author", "admin"), posts.create);
router.delete("/:id", protect, allow("admin"), users.remove);

slides.title: Ownership checks
slides.html:
Ownership

Ownership checks

  • Roles aren't enough: whose post is it?
  • Owners and admins can edit
  • Compare ObjectIds with .equals()

controllers/posts.js

export const update = async (req, res) => {
  const post = await Post.findById(req.params.id);
  if (!post) return res.status(404).json({ message: "Post not found" });
 
  const isOwner = post.author.equals(req.user._id);
  if (!isOwner && req.user.role !== "admin")
    return res.status(403).json({ message: "Not your post" });
 
  const { title, body, tags, status } = req.body;
  Object.assign(post, { title, body, tags, status });
  res.json(await post.save());
};

slides.title: Password reset flow
slides.html:
Reset

Password reset flow

1

Request

POST /auth/forgot {email}: always reply "If that email exists, we sent a link"

2

Token

Create a random token, save its hash + 15 min expiry on the user

3

Email

Send /reset-password?token=... (Nodemailer, Week 8)

4

Reset

POST /auth/reset {token, password}: check hash + expiry, save, clear token

slides.title: Register
slides.html:
Build

Register

  • Validate first
  • 409 if the email is taken
  • Never return the password

controllers/auth.js

export const register = async (req, res) => {
  const { name, email, password } = req.body;
  if (!name || !email || !password || password.length < 8)
    return res.status(400).json({ message: "Name, email and 8+ char password required" });
 
  if (await User.exists({ email: email.toLowerCase() }))
    return res.status(409).json({ message: "Email already registered" });
 
  const user = await User.create({ name, email, password }); // hashed by hook
  setAuthCookie(res, user);
  res.status(201).json({ user: { id: user.id, name, role: user.role } });
};
